title: Multiplayer/Emojis
wikitext:
'''Emojis''' may be used in chat by selecting them from the '''Emoji Menu''', or by typing the corresponding emote code in brackets. '''[0]''' for [[File:emojis000.png|18px|class=inline|link=]], '''[42]''' for [[File:emojis042.png|18px|class=inline|link=]], '''[111]''' for [[File:emojis111.png|18px|class=inline|link=]], and so on.

Shown below are all of the chat emotes available in-game.
